title: The column-header row is sticky to the top during vertical scroll and the Subtotal header is sticky in both axes
preconditions: 1. Enough rows exist to force vertical scrolling; the window is narrow enough to also force horizontal scrolling.
steps: 1. Scroll down through the rows and watch the header row.
2. Scroll right and watch the Subtotal header cell.
expected: 1. The column-header row stays stuck to the top during vertical scroll.
2. The Subtotal header cell stays visible in BOTH axes — stuck to the top while scrolling down and pinned right while scrolling sideways.
